parameters.query: SELECT message, created_at FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT id_cita_dentalink, fecha_turno, hora_turno FROM recordatorios_enviados WHERE telefono = $1 AND confirmado_at IS NULL AND cancelado_at IS NULL AND fecha_turno >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Jujuy')::date ORDER BY fecha_turno, hora_turno
SELECT message->'additional_kwargs'->>'source' AS fuente, message->>'type' AS tipo FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id = $1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id::text AS id, contenido FROM knowledge_base WHERE id IN (20, 21, 24, 25, 36, 39, 40, 45, 41, 29, 30, 37, 42, 44, 3, 22, 23, 1, 26, 28, 43, 32, 33) UNION ALL (SELECT 'asiri:' || id::text AS id, left(contenido, 600) AS contenido FROM knowledge_base WHERE metadata->>'asiri' = 'true' AND coalesce(metadata->>'archivado', '') <> 'true' AND id NOT IN (20, 21, 24, 25, 36, 39, 40, 45, 41, 29, 30, 37, 42, 44, 3, 22, 23, 1, 26, 28, 43, 32, 33) ORDER BY id LIMIT 12) UNION ALL SELECT 'dir:' || clave AS id, valor AS contenido FROM agente_directrices WHERE clave IN ('notas_para_asiri', 'menu_bienvenida') OR left(clave, 4) = 'msg_' ORDER BY 1
